notes.title: Version 0.9.80
notes.content:
[h3]New features and optimization:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now you can rename items in the menu list (to be able to find them easily later)
[*] The views / downloads counter is now optional and can be turned off
[*] Better memory use for GIF recordings
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]
